title: Securing the networks that run your plant

scenes.headline: The network that runs your plant is now a target.
scenes.voice: The network that runs your plant was built for reliability, not for attackers. Today it is often connected to the office network, and to the internet beyond it.

scenes.headline: One weak link reaches the control systems.
lines: Remote access left open for vendors
No record of what moves where
scenes.voice: On a flat network, one infected laptop or one open remote connection for a vendor can reach the systems that control production, and nobody can see what moved where. Attackers know that production systems are rarely patched, and that every hour of downtime is expensive.

scenes.headline: Separate, control, and watch.
scenes.voice: FOG Technologies Nexus starts with an assessment of how your plant network really works. Then we separate operational systems from the office, control remote access, and monitor the traffic that crosses between them. Your team receives a clear report, and a plan it can maintain.

scenes.headline: Request an executive briefing
scenes.voice: It all starts with a careful assessment of your plant network. Request an executive briefing, and write to CEO at fogtechnexus.space.
